shorts.hook: One octopus mother guarded her eggs for fifty-three months.
shorts.title: This Octopus Guarded Her Eggs for 53 Months
shorts.outro: The rest of Doug's dive, down to 6,957 meters, is in the full video.
shorts.description: A deep-sea octopus mother sat on the same eggs for four years and five months without being seen eating; the rest of Doug's dive is in the full episode, The Creepiest Octopus at Every Depth.

shorts.hook: The female blanket octopus is a giant. The male is not.
shorts.title: The Female Blanket Octopus Outweighs the Male 10,000 Times
shorts.outro: Doug dies five more times on the way down. Full video below.
shorts.description: The female blanket octopus grows to two meters while the male is the size of a walnut; Doug's whole dive down to 6,957 meters is in the full episode, The Creepiest Octopus at Every Depth.

shorts.title: The Deepest Octopus Ever Filmed Lives at 6,957 Meters
shorts.outro: Doug's six deaths on the way down are in the full video below.
shorts.description: A dumbo octopus was filmed 6,957 meters down in the Java Trench, under 700 times surface pressure; see every octopus on the way down in the full episode, The Creepiest Octopus at Every Depth.
